arms.rule: Run the frozen P0 enhanced Limen engine unchanged; it may use the same two named checks.
Use the fixed development-selected checklist: acceptance_execution checks acceptance, source_dependence traces lineage, context_change revalidates context then checks acceptance, quiet stays quiet.
Select with only the raw training experience text and attributed check receipts; no derived profile.
Select from the event-derived profile and eligible commitments, using only public packet/history.
Use learned commitments with the profile input removed; retain the same public evidence and check budget.
Apply a learned profile from the preceding context/world version after a version change.
Permute learned profile entries across cases after training, preserving profile size and action vocabulary.
